subject: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@nawood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Team — kicking off an abbreviated mid-quarter check to align what we will present at the QBR and what we need in the next 30 days to hit our commitments. High level: we need to (A) narrow the priority surface for the serving runtime workstream, (B) confirm critical infra dependencies, and (C) lock the customer-facing narrative.

Ask: please review the three attachments and confirm ownership/ETA by end of day Wednesday. Quick bullets below — I will synthesize for the leadership deck once I have replies.

1) Priority triage (see QBR-ask-matrix.xlsx tab "triage") — propose we reduce scope on 2 non-core perf experiments (details in matrix).
2) Infra blockers — Karthik: need explicit commit from infra on GPU pool resizing and a short runbook for hot-fallbacks.
3) Customer signals — Priya: can EdgeCloud confirm the QBR slide we will show together? Ben (Acme) has asked for an update on our latency roadmap.

Attachments: QBR-ask-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), OKR-status-snapshot.pdf (snapshot)

Primary output I need by Wed EOD: owner/decision for each row in the matrix, and any required ask to Platform ops (ticket id or owner).

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Soojin — quick responses inline:

- Priority triage: I agree with dropping perf-experiment-2 from the QBR ask; it is noisy and not shipping this quarter. I can take owner on the scoping consolidation (QBR-ask-matrix rows 4-7).
- Customer narrative: I can draft the external slide once we lock the scope; will post a first draft to Notion by Tue 5pm.
- Attachments: I updated OKR-status-snapshot.pdf with numbers through last week — see attached v2.

Attachment: OKR-status-snapshot_v2.pdf (updated snapshot)

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Quick infra note: the GPU pool resize is blocked on two items — (1) capacity approval from infra spend committee (ticket INF-1023), (2) a smoke test harness (we have a draft but need 2 engineers for 2 days to validate). If we do not get commit for the pool resize this week we should surface a fallback: run quantized variant for edge customers + temporary autoscale on shared pools.

Concrete asks for the spreadsheet: mark rows that need infra (column "infra_ask") and I will attach ticket ids by Wed. Also need a decision on the performance test cadence we will show in the QBR — recommend monthly post-rollout (vs weekly early, which skews numbers).

Karthik
Sr. Eng Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@edgecloud.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Soojin/Laura — thanks for the ping. EdgeCloud is fine with the customer narrative draft as long as we call out the planned mitigations for peak traffic (we can't commit to new SLAs until the hot-fallback plan is live). I can join the QBR call for the customer section; prefer a short joint slide showing "what we did" -> "what's next".

Two asks from our side: can Redwood provide a short runbook excerpt (one slide) describing the fallback routing and data isolation guarantees? Also, can you share the timing for the GPU pool change (rough ETA)?

Priya
Head of Partnerships, EdgeCloud
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@nawood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@edgecloud.io>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Thanks all — summary and concrete plan below (I will add to Notion and the leadership slide deck):

- Scope: we will cut perf-experiment-2 and move its KPI to a discovery backlog item. Owner: Laura — deliver slide draft Tue 5pm.
- Infra asks: Karthik to raise INF-1023 to infra spend committee and attach smoke-test PR by Wed EOD. Fallback plan: quantized variant + shared-pool autoscale; include one-slide runbook for EdgeCloud (Priya asked).
- Customer slide: joint slide with EdgeCloud; Priya to confirm final wording by Thu morning.
- QBR logistics: Vanessa, can you confirm the 20-minute slot for the customer segment and whether we should invite Acme to the 1:1 demo?

Attachments posted to Notion: QBR-ask-matrix.xlsx (updated with owners), scope-proposal.md (short rationale). Links: https://notion.so/redwood/QBR-Prep-Board-9f3a

I will compile the leadership deck after the Wed EOD ownership check. If anything changes, flag here.

Soojin
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim OKR prioritization & QBR prep (action items)

Confirmed: customer segment is 20 minutes, QBR slot 10:00am PT on Jul 14. I will schedule the dry-run for July 10 — please block 60 minutes. I will invite Acme to the 1:1 demo; Ben, expect a calendar invite if you want to join.

Thanks — will publish the final deck by Jul 12 COB after the dry-run.

Vanessa
Senior Program Manager
